The token `sbp_f5ad980bd19f4edd...` appears in **10+ git commits** inside `.rork/history/main/*.json` — those are Rork's **auto-committed conversation-history files** that get pushed to your GitHub repo:

This chat (you + me only)

Rork auto-saves conversation → .rork/history/main/*.json
